summary: Reproduced that the checked-out DSV4/DSV3.2 serving path rendered request-level and message-level tool schemas, including DSML instructions, when tool_choice was none. The fix removes tool metadata from the copied encoder input for that choice while retaining tools for auto and leaving the request objects unchanged.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before prompt-level regression. Both DSV4 and DSV3.2 prompts contained ## Tools and request/message tool names with tool_choice=none. The run also exposed an initially over-specific DSV3.2 auto-marker assertion, which was corrected to account for its function_calls spelling. Raw output: reports/j-55e145f1d06c/raw/pytest_before_fix.txt

Passing-after regression and boundaries: neither encoder exposes tool instructions or names for none; both preserve tools for auto; input request objects are not mutated. Result: 2 passed, 4 subtests passed. Raw output: reports/j-55e145f1d06c/raw/pytest_after_fix_targeted.txt
Full serving-chat unit module. Result: 137 passed, 72 subtests passed. Raw output: reports/j-55e145f1d06c/raw/pytest_after_fix_full.txt
Formatting/lint command could not run because ruff is not installed in the prepared interpreter; no environment packages were changed.

gpu_execution_evidence: The defect and regression are in CPU-side prompt construction before model execution. The assigned ROCm device was visible as one AMD Instinct MI350X with torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2, but an unrelated GPU smoke would not validate DSV4 encoding. See reports/j-55e145f1d06c/raw/gpu_environment.txt.
remaining_limitations: DeepSeek-V4-Flash weights were not available, so no full model HTTP generation was run and no claim is made about model semantics or generated text after the corrected prompt.
The qualified tiny Llama fixture was not used because it can validate transport and engine execution only, not the DeepSeek-V4-specific encoder or DSML behavior.
No native components were changed or rebuilt.
Ruff was absent from the prepared interpreter; git diff --check and the full relevant unit module passed.
